pmcro.seed.purpose: immutable request ingress for a fresh Cycle

orchestrator.route.purpose: admit, deny, select context, and route

planner.plan.purpose: minimum plan over registered checked resources

maker.result.purpose: execution result and evidence; never a verdict

checker.verdict.purpose: independent PASS, FAIL, INCOMPLETE, or BLOCKED verdict

reflector.reflect.purpose: one earned constraint and exactly one unexecuted next seed

capability.invoke.purpose: invoke one admitted registered capability during MAKE

capability.result.purpose: return capability evidence without granting authority

resource.registration.purpose: register a checker-backed immutable resource record

resource.resolution.purpose: planner-facing admissibility result from registry state

invariants: message kind ownership does not grant execution authority
messages are transport data and never cognitive phase injection
capability invocation is legal only during MAKE
reflector.reflect never executes its emitted next seed
